title: Verify Product evidence for krn ship
body:
GLOBAL `krn ship` merges a Product PR without checking Product evidence: with no review record, no Ticket/task, or a failed or skipping gate, a dry run returns 0 (recon in `.krn/runs/claude-merge-path-recon`). Product already exposes `scripts/pr-preflight.mjs` as its admission check. Extend it into the ship verifier: require the exact-head review record (full PASS panel or a recorded override), require the `gate` check-run from GitHub Actions on the head, and declare the verifier in `krn.ship.json`. Decision: `.krn/runs/claude-merge-path-design/decision.md`.
Acceptance: a falsifier matrix of missing or invalid evidence fails on the base and every case is refused on the head, while a complete evidence set passes.
